codeSamples.code:
<?php

$baseUrl = 'https://api.spryng.nl/v2/contacts/%7BcontactId%7D';
$ch = curl_init();
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_URL, $baseUrl);

$headers = [
     'X-Api-Key' => 'YOUR_KEY_HERE'
    ];

curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, $headers);


curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);

$response = curl_exec($ch);
$info = curl_getinfo($ch);

curl_close($ch);

if ($info['http_code'] >= 400) {
    echo 'Error! HTTP code: ' . $info['http_code'] . ', Response: ' . $response;
} else {
    echo 'Success! Response: ' . $response;
}
?>

sections.title: API overview
sections.content:
This endpoint allows you to retrieve data associated with a contact in a single API call. The request can be filtered by: Opt out status, date created, destination, groupId, first name, last name or quick name and other properties listed below. This is the ideal tool for synchronizing your contact list from another system, such as a CRM, an e-commerce platform, or a customer database, ensuring your contacts are always up-to-date.

The documentation in this section contains the core reference information you will need to retrieve contacts via our API, including required headers, cURL sample & error codes.

Before you start your implementation, please check you have your Account, API Key and Base URL set up and have familiarised yourself with our implementation prerequisites.

sections.title: Headers
sections.content:
These parameters are mandatory to be provided in the header of your request. If not provided, or incorrect, your request will fail.

HeaderTypeDescription
X-Api-KeyStringAPI Key value for authorization

Example request header:
GET https://api.spryng.nl/v2/contacts/{contactId}
-H 'Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY'


Optional input path parameters

The below parameters are optional within the path, they are designed to provide you further capability to filter your requests.

ParameterTypeDescription
optOutStatusQueryFilter contacts by the optOutStatus allowed values are subscribed or unsubscribed
sortByQuerySort contacts. Available values: Name | CreatedAt
sortOrderQuerySets the sorting direction. Default = descending. Available values: Asc & Desc
searchQueryAbility to search using the following: address | first name | last name | quick name. Searching will retrieve information from all parameters
destinationQueryFilter contacts by the Destination. Value should be a valid ISO3166 country code. For example: GB | DE | IT | US
groupIdQueryFilter contacts by a certain groupId only

sections.title: Responses
sections.content:
The standard responses for this API are listed below. For a full list of possible REST API status codes, please refer to this guide.

Success
200 OK
Success response with the following example body.
{
    "data": {
        "contactId": "c129b89f-515a-43e1-b990-91fc2de3d566",
        "accountReference": "SPNL0000000",
        "firstName": "Team",
        "lastName": "Octopus",
        "quickName": "TOCT1",
        "lastUpdatedBy": "907da4a7-bb93-4772-8af4-a95cc59e5a91",
        "smsoptOutStatus": "Subscribed",
        "createTimestamp": "2024-11-25T13:28:17.087042Z",
        "lastUpdateTimestamp": "2024-11-25T13:28:17.087042Z",
        "addresses": [
            {
                "addressId": "7ba907b4-ff85-4825-a413-d6b634b16536",
                "addressType": "MSISDN",
                "addressValue": "+447711000022",
                "destinationCode": "GB"
            }
        ],
        "contactMetadata": {
            "team": "octopus"
        }
    }
}

Error codes
404 Not Found
The server couldn't process the request as the contactId provided doesn't exist or has an invalid format.

Response example
{
    "errors": [
        {
            "errorCode": "contact_not_found",
            "errorMessage": "Contact not found."
        }
    ]
}

401 Unauthorized
The server couldn't process the request due to an invalid or missing authentication header.

Response example
{
    "title": "An error occurred while processing the request",
    "status": 401,
    "errors": {},
    "internalErrors": [
        {
            "message": "Pipeline",
            "metadata": {
                "unauthenticatedError": "Request for authenticated route '/v2/contacts/65ff9fe8-428e-40b0-bcee-1e656db5fdb3' was unauthenticated"
            }
        }
    ]
}
